retrievalProfile.description: A centered full-body portrait set against a bright blue sky with a distinct horizontal rainbow gradient header containing mixed typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered male figure in casual 80s attire standing against a vibrant blue sky with soft white clouds, topped by a horizontal band featuring a yellow-to-pink rainbow gradient and two distinct typographic styles.
coreVisualRelationships: Horizontal rainbow band anchored to the top edge
Centered vertical subject providing a focal point
Contrast between the warm rainbow header and cool blue sky
Juxtaposition of bold geometric sans-serif and elegant italic script

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered, full-body portrait occupying the middle two-thirds of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The horizontal rainbow gradient bar at the top edge.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bold text in the header, moves down to the subject's face, and follows the body down to the horizon line.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Expansive blue sky surrounding the central figure.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Sky blue background providing a cool, open atmosphere.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Dark navy and black of the subject's clothing to ground the image.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Yellow, orange, and pink within the top gradient bar.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the header and sky, with naturalistic values in the central portrait.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Geometric sans-serif paired with a high-contrast calligraphic script.
letterConstructionRules: Primary text uses wide, uniform stroke weights with open counters.
Secondary text uses slanted, fluid strokes with varying thickness.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between a rigid, modern sans-serif and a traditional, flowing script.

preserve: Uppercase sans-serif for the primary name
avoid: Serif fonts for the primary name
Placing text directly over the sky

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric uppercase structure of the primary text.
Approximates the calligraphic, high-contrast script style.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a centered full-body portrait of a person in 80s casual wear against a bright blue sky with soft clouds. Add a horizontal bar at the very top with a yellow-to-pink rainbow gradient.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place bold uppercase geometric sans-serif text on the left side of the gradient bar and italic script text on the right side, both in black.

verificationChecks: Is the rainbow bar at the top edge?
Is the primary text uppercase sans-serif?
Is the background a blue sky?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original subject
Exact wording of the original title

mustAchieve: Clean separation between the header and the image

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the gradient bar is perfectly horizontal.
Check that the text is vertically centered within the bar.
Verify the sky has a naturalistic cloud distribution.
Confirm the subject is in sharp focus against the background.
recipe.reuseFormula: Centered portrait + Sky background + Top rainbow gradient bar + Mixed typography overlay.
